name: pack-objects-into-box
instruction: Place the car, shoe, toothbrush and hammer fully inside the open box, pointing the car nose, shoe toe, toothbrush head and hammer striking face left. Return both arms to origin.
reset_instruction: Orange toy car, red shoe, blue electric toothbrush, claw hammer, open cardboard box. Trace the initial box footprint and record front-left reference. Record matched initial layout and neutral poses for both arms. Confirm ACT start pose, all three camera views, open empty grippers and station stop control. Reset to the identical scene between policies.
success_question: 4 objects fully inside, front-left, settled; box stays within initial footprint and grippers open. All four correct and arms at origin. Every qualifying object must be released, settled for 2 seconds and unsupported by a gripper. Full success also requires both arms at the recorded origin.

milestones.criterion: 1 objects fully inside, front-left, settled; box stays within initial footprint and grippers open.
2 objects fully inside, front-left, settled; box stays within initial footprint and grippers open.
3 objects fully inside, front-left, settled; box stays within initial footprint and grippers open.
4 objects fully inside, front-left, settled; box stays within initial footprint and grippers open. All four correct and arms at origin.
